answer: Admission proof-of-work at the quartz gate: each identity must burn 500 CPU-hours (~$12 cloud) solving a unique puzzle. The karst of recycled solutions floods with fresh wallets, but each clone repeats the full burn. The anchor is marginal cost: 1,000 sybils = $12k, while a real user pays once. Attacker returns go negative before 50 identities. Works because admission cost scales linearly per identity and cannot be amortized.
